we present a reliable, fast, and cost‐effective diagnostic approach for comprehensive genetic profiling of advanced NSCLCs that is suitable for routine molecular diagnostics and that is capable of identifying actionable targets in the vast majority of patients.
the combination of comprehensive DNA/RNA sequencing is a reliable, fast and cost‐effective method for the molecular workup of NSCLC patients in routine clinical diagnostics.
comprehensive NGS‐based molecular diagnostics is reliable and cost‐effective, and can be performed in routine patient care.

the molecular characterization of tumors and the development of diagnostic tests to support individualized cancer therapy and to improve the outcome of cancer patients.
the development and application of new technologies in the field of personalized medicine.
the development of new diagnostic methods in molecular diagnostics and the implementation of these methods in routine diagnostics.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the NGS‐based diagnostic approach is superior to single‐gene testing.
the NGS‐based approach is a feasible and clinically useful diagnostic tool to identify patients with advanced NSCLC who might be eligible for treatment with targeted agents.
the presented NGS‐based approach is an efficient, cost‐effective and reliable diagnostic method to guide treatment in advanced NSCLC.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
NGS‐based testing for actionable alterations in advanced NSCLC is feasible in a routine diagnostic setting.
the NGS‐based approach described is a reliable and fast tool to detect actionable genetic alterations in NSCLC patients and to identify those who are eligible for targeted therapies.

the NGS‐based approach presented here is a reliable and cost‐effective method that allows the identification of a large number of actionable mutations and gene fursions in NSCLC, which may be used to guide therapeutic decisions and to stratify patients for clinical trials.
The main takeaway from our work is that

NGS‐based comprehensive genetic profiling of advanced NSCLCs is feasible in routine diagnostics, providing reliable results with minimal tissue requirements, low dropout rates and fast turnaround times.

the implementation of comprehensive, parallel DNA and RNA sequencing into clinical routine can provide a reliable, cost‐effective and timely tool for identification of actionable alterations in NSCLC.

the use of NGS for comprehensive, parallel DNA and RNA sequencing in routine molecular diagnostics is feasible and can be performed at a high level of reliability, while providing clinically actionable results for the majority of advanced NSCLCs.
